text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by roughly four hours a week per rep. Most of that went straight into prep and follow-up.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete and consistent, so managers could finally coach from real conversations instead of memory.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated when we asked to record. Opening with a clear, upfront consent line fixed most of it.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what mattered. Reps still had to add judgment.

Our takeaway: treat AI notes as a first draft, not the final word.

What's your team's experience with AI note-takers?
